pivot: top-left; the image overhangs the screen edge by the glow margin
blend: straight alpha; plate pixels opaque, glow semi-transparent. In Godot draw the glow additively (or rely on 2D HDR glow) and add a PointLight2D/TextureLight2D spill using the blurred emission, pink+cyan, energy ~1.2, range ~600 px
state: static lit (reduce-effects frame); pulses and warm-up are shader/animation driven
